title.value: Combining Parameter-efficient Modules for Task-level Generalisation
title.justification: The extracted title is clear and concise, capturing the main theme of the paper related to parameter-efficient modular designs for task-level generalization.
title.quote: Combining Parameter-efficient Modules for Task-level Generalisation

extractions.description: The paper proposes a modular approach to neural network design, enabling the separation and recombination of skills for systematic task generalization. By using sparse and low-rank adapters, tasks are associated with subsets of 'latent skills,' enhancing sample efficiency in reinforcement and supervised learning.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on neural network architecture for task generalization without a specific focus on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: A modular design encourages neural models to disentangle and recombine different facets of knowledge to generalise more systematically to new tasks.

primary_category.justification: The research does not directly pertain to any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories as it is focused on neural network architecture optimization.
primary_category.quote: We evaluate our latent-skill model in two main settings: 1) multitask reinforcement learning for instruction following on 8 levels of the BabyAI platform; and 2) few-shot fine-tuning of language models on 160 NLP tasks of the CrossFit benchmark.
